name: without a functions block nothing is defined
a definition applies to every query below its block and not to those above
a block may define several functions, in the order written, and the marker may come anywhere in it
a later block adds to the earlier ones
defining a name again replaces it where it was
clearing one function takes away only that one
clearing every function takes away all of them, and a function can be defined again
clearing what was never defined changes nothing
every let is a definition, whether it is a function, a scalar or a table, and nothing else is
semicolons in strings and bodies do not end a definition, and a missing last semicolon is allowed
a definition in a comment is not one
a definition inside a query's own block is part of the query, not a definition
a functions block is not a query, whatever else is in it
a function name that cannot be one, and the wrong number of arguments, clear nothing
